
DELETE-SCENARIO
Delete a scenario from a feature file

USAGE
  fspec delete-scenario <file> <scenario> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path
  <scenario> (required)
    Scenario name to delete

OPTIONS
  --force
    Skip confirmation

EXAMPLES
  1. Delete scenario and update coverage file
  $ fspec delete-scenario spec/features/login.feature "Deprecated scenario"
  ✓ Deleted scenario "Deprecated scenario" from login.feature
  Updated coverage file

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-scenario
  fspec delete-scenarios

NOTES
  • Scenario name must match exactly (case-sensitive)
  • Automatically removes scenario from .feature.coverage file if it exists
  • Coverage statistics (totalScenarios, coveredScenarios, coveragePercent) are recalculated
